description: Logs that someone on the team contacted a person, for example by email, direct message or call. A not_contacted person moves to contacted, and a person with no owner gets the contacting member as owner. A later stage or an existing owner stays, and update_person changes them. memberId falls back to the signed-in user. Called with an API key and no memberId, it logs an activity without a member and sets no owner. Returns the new activity and the updated person.

id.description: The aut_... id from list_people, or author.id on a mention

memberId.description: The user id of the member who reached out. Defaults to the signed-in member. With an API key and no value, the activity has no member.

note.description: A short summary of what was sent or said.

occurredAt.description: Defaults to now. Otherwise send the contact time as ISO 8601 or epoch ms.

name: log_activity
title: Log activity
